0c04dd0f-498b-4bc9-9451-070da386823e.summary_md: Jesse Day cruised to a 20-7 record and a massive +1651 spread at King's Cup 2019, headlined by a 709-274 demolition of Cedric Lewis and a 93.2% bingo find rate (69/74) against strong opposition including four meetings with Nigel Richards (2-2) and three with Akshay Bhandarkar (1-2). Pre-endgame play was where the tournament was actually lost or won, bleeding 41% of all win-probability lost across just 21 errors — more than double the share of the far more numerous early and mid-game mistakes — and it was here that the single costliest blunder occurred: in Round 23 vs. Richards, Jesse played N1 BASKeD for 48 instead of the bingo N1 DiSBARK for 96, a 44.4% win-probability swing. Missed bingos were a recurring theme rather than the norm, with five drops (MEAGRES, AM(B)ITION, DiSBARK, AGEnTIV(AL), REMI(N)TED) accounting for a disproportionate 61.8% of the win probability lost to that category, while ordinary tactical missteps like the Round 24 EART(HM)EN-for-A(GUE) swap against Jakkrit Klaphajone also proved costly. Endgame errors, by contrast, cost zero win probability despite bleeding the most raw equity (266), underscoring that the damage was already done well before the final exchanges.
0c04dd0f-498b-4bc9-9451-070da386823e.title: King's Cup 2019

12dd6445-9dfc-4859-b110-6fcd966234b7.summary_md: Jesse ran the table at 13-1 (+1778) to finish first of 15 in Division 12, anchored by a 100% bingo find rate (33/33) and a league-best 1.32 mistakes score among 208 qualified players — the only loss coming in a shootout with dang3rous (374-537). Most of the win probability actually bled away early and mid-game (41.0% and 28.1% of the lost win% respectively, versus almost nothing at pre-endgame or endgame), and it was ordinary tactical misplays rather than missed bingos that dominated the list — the costliest single error was in Round 9 against Bhawani Cheerath, where HARdIER (78) was played instead of the superior HERb(A)RIA (90) for a 5.5% win probability swing. Since Collins League games reject invalid plays outright, no phonies were possible for either side, so that isn't a point of credit here — the story is simply dominant, near-flawless positional Scrabble across the field.
12dd6445-9dfc-4859-b110-6fcd966234b7.title: Collins League - Season 20
